strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}{03}アスロイト王国

 大陸最大{02}の版図をもつ超大国。首都は{03}ガスニ
ッツ。酷寒{02}の地から灼熱の砂漠地帯にまで及ぶ
広大な領土を支配する、{01}1500年以上{02}の歴史
を持つ王国である。

 経済の根幹は農業であるが、王都{03}ガスニッツ
{02}の繁栄とは裏腹に庶民の暮らしは豊かとは言い
難い。
 国の富は、人口の{01}3{03}パーセント{02}に過ぎない貴
族階級や教会に集中し、国民の大多数が貧しい
暮らしに苦しんでいる。特に王族と上級貴族の
生活の派手さは、国の財政までも圧迫し、官位
の金銭売買などの政治の退廃へと結びついてい
る。

 平和な時代が千年以上も続いたため、国民に
とって「{03}アスロイト王国軍」{02}とは国土や自分達
を守るために存在するものではなく、農民や地
方都市の反乱を鎮圧するためにのみ存在する
「敵」となってしまっている。
 騎士や将軍や元帥といった肩書きも、民衆に
とって憧れではなく憎しみの対象となっており、
身分間の溝は深い。
 さらに、近年は王国軍内部の軍規の乱れもひ
どく、治安維持の機能さえも全く果たしていな
いようだ。王国軍には千人規模の農民の武力蜂
起を鎮圧する力さえもなく、国王の直轄領内の
争乱であっても、諸侯や地方豪族に多大な謝礼
と共に出陣を依頼し、鎮圧しているといった具
合だ。
 政治も軍事も退廃・堕落し、広大な領土の支
配は完全に行き詰まっていると見てよいだろう。
地方は半独立状態で、国王の令もほとんど届か
ない。特に、{03}アスロイト{02}の四天王とも言うべき
{03}ファルツ、デューラー、アスカニア、ウェッテ
ィン{02}の四公爵の力は強く、{01}1度公布{02}された政令
であっても彼等の反対で覆されることさえある。

 {01}35年前{02}の地下遺跡の発見は、慢性的な財政
難に苦しむ{03}アスロイト王国{02}にとってもやはり嬉
しい出来事であったようだ。
 といっても、彼等は、傾いた財政を立て直し
たわけでも、貧困に苦しむ庶民達に分け与えた
わけでもなかった。発見される財宝はすべて王
宮の夜を豪華にする資金へとかわり、国王と上
級貴族達は毎夜の饗宴に溺れていった。

 魔物の出現によって、たったの{01}3年{02}で地下遺
跡からの歳入が途絶えてしまったことは彼らに
とっても誤算だっただろう。
 だが、魔物に対する軍隊の派遣、{03}アスラ・フ
ァエル{02}の城壁の建設などで、庶民の負担はさら
に増大していったにもかかわらず、彼等はその
饗宴をやめなかった。
 彼等にとって、魔物に殺された人々の命など、
宴に出される{03}ワイン{02}の味や女性達の{03}ドレス{02}の柄
よりも関心の薄いことだったのだろうか・・・
 地下遺跡という金脈が断たれたにもかかわら
ず、派手な生活を改めなかったため、当然、国
の財政はさらに悪化していく。


 {03}アスラ・ファエル{02}が分厚い城壁により封印さ
れてからたった{01}8年後{02}、{03}アスロイト王国{02}と{03}バイ
レステ共和国{02}は自らの手で城門の封印を解く。
財政難に苦しむこの二大国は、{03}アスラ・ファエ
ル{02}に眠ったままの財宝を手放したくなかったの
であろう。魔物の恐怖は人々の記憶に鮮明に残
っていたはずだが、彼等にとっては財宝の方が
重要だったのだろうか。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kingdom of Asroit

A superpower with the largest dominion on the
continent. Its capital is Gasnitz. This kingdom,
with more than 1,500 years of history, rules a
vast territory that stretches from bitterly
cold lands to scorching desert.

Its economy rests on agriculture, but for all
the prosperity of the royal capital Gasnitz, the
common people can hardly be called well off. The
nation's wealth is concentrated in the nobility,
a mere 3 percent of the population, and in the
Church, while the great majority of its people
struggle in poverty. The extravagance of the
royal family and the high nobility in particular
strains even the state's finances, and has led
to political decay such as the buying and selling
of offices.

After more than a thousand years of peace,
the people no longer see the "Royal Army of
Asroit" as something that exists to protect
the land or themselves. It has become an
"enemy" that exists solely to crush the revolts
of farmers and provincial towns. Titles such as
knight, general and marshal are objects not of
longing but of hatred among the people, and the
gulf between the classes is deep. Moreover,
discipline within the Royal Army has grown badly
lax in recent years, and it seems to fail entirely
even at keeping the peace. The Royal Army
lacks the strength to put down even an armed
uprising of a thousand farmers; even
disturbances within the king's own domain are
suppressed by asking the lords and provincial
magnates to take the field, in return for lavish
rewards. Politics and the military alike have
decayed and fallen into depravity, and it is fair
to say that rule over this vast territory has
reached a complete impasse. The provinces are
semi-independent, and the king's decrees hardly
reach them. Especially powerful are the four
dukes Pfalz, Durer, Ascania and Wettin, who
might be called the Four Kings of Asroit; even a
decree already proclaimed may be overturned by
their opposition.

The discovery of the underground ruins 35
years ago was a welcome event for the
Kingdom of Asroit too, suffering as it was
from chronic financial trouble. That said, they
neither rebuilt their tottering finances nor
shared anything with the commoners suffering
in poverty. All the treasure found became
funds to make the palace's nights more
splendid, and the king and the high nobility
drowned themselves in banquets night after
night.

The appearance of monsters, which cut off
revenue from the underground ruins after a
mere 3 years, must have been a miscalculation
even for them. Yet though the burden on the
commoners grew still heavier with the dispatch
of armies against the monsters and the building
of the walls of Asla Fael, they did not stop
their banquets. Were the lives of those killed by
monsters of less concern to them than the
taste of the wine at table or the patterns on
the ladies' gowns...? And since they did not
change their lavish way of life even after the
gold vein of the underground ruins was cut off,
the nation's finances naturally grew worse still.

A mere 8 years after Asla Fael was sealed
behind its thick walls, the Kingdom of Asroit
and the Republic of Baileste undid the seal on
its gates with their own hands. These two
great powers, suffering from financial trouble,
must not have wished to give up the treasure
still sleeping in Asla Fael. The terror of the
monsters should still have been vivid in people's
memories, but did the treasure matter more to
them?{0b:07}

Kingdom of Asroit

A superpower with the largest dominion on the continent. Its capital is Gasnitz. This kingdom, with more than 1,500 years of history, rules a vast territory that stretches from bitterly cold lands to scorching desert.

Its economy rests on agriculture, but for all the prosperity of the royal capital Gasnitz, the common people can hardly be called well off. The nation's wealth is concentrated in the nobility, a mere 3 percent of the population, and in the Church, while the great majority of its people struggle in poverty. The extravagance of the royal family and the high nobility in particular strains even the state's finances, and has led to political decay such as the buying and selling of offices.

After more than a thousand years of peace, the people no longer see the "Royal Army of Asroit" as something that exists to protect the land or themselves. It has become an "enemy" that exists solely to crush the revolts of farmers and provincial towns. Titles such as knight, general and marshal are objects not of longing but of hatred among the people, and the gulf between the classes is deep. Moreover, discipline within the Royal Army has grown badly lax in recent years, and it seems to fail entirely even at keeping the peace. The Royal Army lacks the strength to put down even an armed uprising of a thousand farmers; even disturbances within the king's own domain are suppressed by asking the lords and provincial magnates to take the field, in return for lavish rewards. Politics and the military alike have decayed and fallen into depravity, and it is fair to say that rule over this vast territory has reached a complete impasse. The provinces are semi-independent, and the king's decrees hardly reach them. Especially powerful are the four dukes Pfalz, Durer, Ascania and Wettin, who might be called the Four Kings of Asroit; even a decree already proclaimed may be overturned by their opposition.

The discovery of the underground ruins 35 years ago was a welcome event for the Kingdom of Asroit too, suffering as it was from chronic financial trouble. That said, they neither rebuilt their tottering finances nor shared anything with the commoners suffering in poverty. All the treasure found became funds to make the palace's nights more splendid, and the king and the high nobility drowned themselves in banquets night after night.

The appearance of monsters, which cut off revenue from the underground ruins after a mere 3 years, must have been a miscalculation even for them. Yet though the burden on the commoners grew still heavier with the dispatch of armies against the monsters and the building of the walls of Asla Fael, they did not stop their banquets. Were the lives of those killed by monsters of less concern to them than the taste of the wine at table or the patterns on the ladies' gowns...? And since they did not change their lavish way of life even after the gold vein of the underground ruins was cut off, the nation's finances naturally grew worse still.

A mere 8 years after Asla Fael was sealed behind its thick walls, the Kingdom of Asroit and the Republic of Baileste undid the seal on its gates with their own hands. These two great powers, suffering from financial trouble, must not have wished to give up the treasure still sleeping in Asla Fael. The terror of the monsters should still have been vivid in people's memories, but did the treasure matter more to them?

strings.read: バイレステ共和国
strings.en: Republic of Baileste
strings.tl: Republic of Baileste

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}バイレステ共和国

 世界の7割近くの富を集める超大国。国土面
積はアスロイト王国に遠く及ばないが、アスロ
イト王国の数倍の国家資産を持つ豊かな国であ
る。
 首都「大バイレステ」は「海の都」と呼ばれ、
世界中の珍しい工芸品や農作物がすべて集まる
大陸最大の都市である。 

 リガレア海沿岸は、大陸の北側に比べ気候も
温暖で、古代から経済的に豊かであり、商工業
の発展している都市国家の多い地域であった。
 バイレステ共和国も、元々はリガレア海沿岸
に幾つもある都市国家の1つに過ぎなかった。
小さな漁村からスタートしたこの小さな都市国
家は、5百年以上もかけて徐々にライバルの都
市国家を蹴落とし、リガレア海の海上貿易を完
全に掌握することで今の地位を築いていった。

 バイレステ共和国の政治は、元首を筆頭に、
共和国国会・元老院・四十人委員会などのいく
つもの機関によって運営されている。
 政体は、一個人や一家族に権力が集中するの
を極度に防ぐように出来ていたばかりでなく、
一機関だけが強大な権力を振るうことのないよ
う配慮されていた。これが、バイレステ共和国
の強さの秘密でもあった。
 他の都市国家が内部の権力争いで自滅してい
る間に、貴族と平民がバイレステのために一致
団結し、航路を拡大し、強力な海軍をさらに充
実させ、属州を増やしてきたのである。

 しかし、超大国となり、ライバルがいなくな
ってからのバイレステ共和国に昔日の面影はな
い。
 かつては市民全員のものであった活気ある政
治の場も、一部の富豪の私有物となり政治に活
力が失せてしまう。金持ちは巧みに税を逃れる
ようになり、税収の落ち込みは政府を圧迫する。
共和国領内は基本的に全て自由貿易地域である
ため、属州同士が独自に交易を始め、バイレス
テやその交易商人は無視されるようになり中央
の力は弱まっていく。
 勇敢で冒険心に富む海の男の代名詞であった
バイレステの民も、バイレステ市が大帝国の首
都となってからは、享楽と欲望と退廃の都で酒
に溺れる哀れな男に成り下がってしまったと言
えば言い過ぎだろうか・・・
 対照的に、各属州の商人達は、重税と、近年
導入され始めた管理貿易政策に苦しみつつも活
気に満ちあふれている。{0b:07}

 対照的に、各属州の商人達は、重税と、近年
導入され始めた管理貿易政策に苦しみつつも活
気に満ちあふれている。{0b:07}
strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Republic of Baileste

A superpower that gathers nearly 70 percent
of the world's wealth. In land area it falls far
short of the Kingdom of Asroit, but it is a rich
nation with national assets several times those
of Asroit. Its capital, "Great Baileste", called
the "City of the Sea", is the largest city on
the continent, where rare crafts and produce
from all over the world gather.

The Rigalean coast, warmer than the north of
the continent, has been economically rich since
antiquity, a region of many city-states with
thriving commerce and industry. The Republic of
Baileste too was originally no more than one of
the many city-states on the Rigalean coast.
Starting out as a small fishing village, this little
city-state spent more than 500 years
gradually bringing down its rival city-states, and
built its present position by seizing complete
control of maritime trade on the Rigalean Sea.

The Republic of Baileste is governed by a
number of bodies under its head of state,
among them the Republican Assembly, the
Senate and the Committee of Forty. The
system was designed not only to rigorously
prevent power from concentrating in one
person or one family, but also to keep any one
body from wielding too great a power. This was
also the secret of the Republic of Baileste's
strength. While other city-states destroyed
themselves with internal power struggles,
nobles and commoners united for Baileste,
expanding its sea routes, further
strengthening its mighty navy, and adding to its
provinces.

However, once it had become a superpower with
no rivals left, the Republic of Baileste kept no
trace of its former self. The lively political
arena that once belonged to all citizens has
become the private property of a few
magnates, and politics has lost its vigor. The
rich have grown adept at evading taxes, and
falling tax revenue squeezes the government.
Since the Republic's territory is in principle one
free-trade zone, the provinces have begun to
trade among themselves, Baileste and its
traders are increasingly ignored, and the power
of the center is waning. Would it be going too
far to say that the people of Baileste, once a
byword for brave, adventurous men of the sea,
have sunk, since the city of Baileste became
the capital of a great empire, into pitiful men
drowning in drink in a city of pleasure, desire
and decadence...? By contrast, the merchants
of each province, though suffering under heavy
taxes and the managed-trade policies
introduced in recent years, are brimming with
vigor.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}ビアストク王国

 大陸の最北端、アスロイト王国のさらに北に
ある辺境の王国。冬長く夏短い酷寒の地である。
 この国より北は永久凍土で、とうてい人の住
めるところではない。人の住める最北限に位置
するこの国は、当然大地の実りも乏しく、極め
て貧しい国である。
 過酷な環境はビアストクの文化にも影響を与
えている。ビアストクに伝わる神話は、優美軽
快な人間味あふれるリガレア神話に比べると荒
々しく暗いものが多い。
 固有の文字を持たなかったため、神話の大部
分はアノイア教の伝播と共に人々の記憶から忘
れ去られてしまったが、一部は民話としてビア
ストクや北アスロイトの民衆に今も伝えられて
いる。
 近世において最も有名な英雄物語である「円
卓の騎士」に登場する騎士グレムト、隠者ファ
ルマも、ビアストク神話の英雄グラストンとフ
ァルモスの物語をモチーフに書かれたものであ
ると言われている。

-追記-
 隠者ファルマが英雄達のために造ったとされ
る3種の武器に非常に酷似した武器が、アスラ
・ファエル内で発見されている。
 ただし、ビアストク神話における記述と、近
世に創作された「円卓の騎士」における記述に
は若干の食い違いがあり、アスラ・ファエル内
で発見されたファルマの武器は両者の特徴を有
している点で非常に興味深い。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kingdom of Biastok

A remote kingdom at the northern tip of the
continent, further north even than the
Kingdom of Asroit. It is a land of bitter cold,
with long winters and short summers. North of
this nation lies permafrost, where people could
never live. Situated at the northernmost limit
of human habitation, this nation naturally has
meager harvests and is extremely poor. The
harsh environment has also influenced Biastok's
culture. Compared with the graceful,
light-hearted and deeply human Rigalean myths,
the myths handed down in Biastok are largely
wild and dark. Since the people had no writing of
their own, most of these myths faded from
memory as the Anoian faith spread, but some
survive as folktales among the people of
Biastok and northern Asroit. The knight Gremt
and the hermit Falma, who appear in "The
Knights of the Round Table", the most famous
heroic tale of recent times, are said to be
based on the stories of Graston and Falmos,
heroes of Biastok myth.

-Addendum-

Weapons that closely resemble the 3 kinds of
weapons the hermit Falma is said to have made
for the heroes have been found in Asla Fael.
However, the accounts in Biastok myth and in
the recently written "The Knights of the
Round Table" differ slightly, and it is of great
interest that the Falma weapons found in Asla
Fael have the features of both.{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Duchy of Luminia

A nation located to the east of the Kingdom of
Asroit. The western half of its land is
scorching desert, and most of its people live in
the fertile grain lands of the east. Great
trading cities dot the shores of Iradeya Bay
and the Terbant Sea, and Bailestean merchants
are a common sight there. The western desert
is now an uninhabited wasteland, but in the
distant past it flourished as the birthplace of
the ancient Iradeyan civilization, the source of
the civilizations of the Rigalean coast.{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kingdom of Krasdar

A nation in the east of the world. With no
industry worth noting, even Bailestean
merchants seldom travel this far. It is a
religious state whose king also serves as a
bishop of the Krasdar Orthodox Church, an
offshoot of the Anoian faith, and the only
nation the Pope's power does not reach.

The defining feature of Krasdar Orthodoxy is
its strict restorationism. It recognizes nothing
as doctrine except what is written in the main
text of the Scriptures, and the only objects of
its faith are the Two Supreme Gods, Zemen
and Zeweak. It does not recognize faith in the
Prophet Anoia, the Thirteen Saints, the angels
or the holy men and women, and its churches
display no sacred statues or paintings of any
kind. In contrast to Lenos, severity and
plainness are the mark of Krasdar.

Before the birth of the Anoian faith, Krasdar
too had many myths and religions, but their
history cannot be learned within Krasdar today,
since nearly all historical texts and ruins were
destroyed as heathen. In truth, however, there
is no shortage of material for studying
Krasdar's ancient religious history. In Anoian
year 226, when the Lenos Empire conquered
the Kingdom of Crixus, which then ruled
Krasdar, many texts and statues were carried
off to Lenos along with its treasure. Indigos,
whose image now adorns the roofs of
cathedrals and noble mansions as a ward
against evil (and who is famous too as the
strongest foe in the Black Passage), was
originally a god handed down in Krasdar, and the
sorcerer Anote, who appears in the opera "Way
of the Heavenly Wind", popular in Baileste a few
years ago, was originally a figure from
Krasdar's myths.

-Addendum-

One year ago, 6 kinds of weapons said to have
been made by the sorcerer Anote were found in
Asla Fael. However, these weapons appear only
in the opera "Way of the Heavenly Wind";
nothing similar can be found in the myths of
Krasdar.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}セフィータ王国

 バイレステ共和国の南東に位置する国。国土
は広いが、その大部分が灼熱の砂漠地帯で、そ
こにはわずかの「砂漠の民」と呼ばれる遊牧部
族が暮らすのみである。
 国民の大部分は沿岸部に点在する通商都市で
生活している。しかし、西側沿岸都市の半分以
上がバイレステ共和国の支配下にあり、貿易で
得られる富のほとんどがバイレステ商人の懐に
入っていく。このため民の大部分は貧しい。

 この国は、数百の遊牧部族が集まって出来た
国である。国王といえども、それぞれの部族に
必要以上に干渉出来ないため、国王の権力は非
常に弱い。その上、各部族のまとまりもないた
め、大国バイレステの支配に反抗する力は持っ
ていない。{0b:07}

{09:0f}{0b:06}セフィータ王国

 バイレステ共和国の南東に位置する国。国土
は広いが、その大部分が灼熱の砂漠地帯で、そ
こにはわずかの「砂漠の民」と呼ばれる遊牧部
族が暮らすのみである。
 国民の大部分は沿岸部に点在する通商都市で
生活している。しかし、西側沿岸都市の半分以
上がバイレステ共和国の支配下にあり、貿易で
得られる富のほとんどがバイレステ商人の懐に
入っていく。このため民の大部分は貧しい。

 この国は、数百の遊牧部族が集まって出来た
国である。国王といえども、それぞれの部族に
必要以上に干渉出来ないため、国王の権力は非
常に弱い。その上、各部族のまとまりもないた
め、大国バイレステの支配に反抗する力は持っ
ていない。{0b:07}
strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kingdom of Sefita

A nation to the southeast of the Republic of
Baileste. Its land is wide, but most of it is
scorching desert, home only to a few nomadic
tribes called the "People of the Desert". Most
of its people live in trading cities dotted along
the coast. However, more than half of the
cities on its western coast are under the rule
of the Republic of Baileste, and nearly all the
wealth gained from trade goes into the pockets
of Bailestean merchants. For this reason most
of its people are poor.

This nation is a gathering of several hundred
nomadic tribes. Even the king cannot interfere
more than necessary with each tribe, so royal
power is very weak. What is more, the tribes
lack unity, and so have no strength to resist
the rule of the great power Baileste.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}{03}ファコルツ公国

 アスロイト王国{02}の西に位置する国。{03}アスロイ
ト{02}と同じく農業中心の国。国の歴史は新しく、
また誕生の経緯も少し変わっている。

 今から{01}2百年前{02}、当時の{03}アスロイト国王{02}が、
お気に入りの小姓にこの地方を{03}プレゼント{02}した。
 その国王の死後、新しく玉座に座った王の息
子は、当然のようにその小姓から領土の返還を
求めたが、その小姓はただ可愛いだけの少年で
はなかった。不敵な彼は、それを無視し{03}ファコ
ルツ公国{02}としてこの地方を独立させる。
 {03}アスロイト{02}の新しい国王は当然激怒したが、
人間の心を知り抜いている{03}ファコルツ公{02}は、
{03}アスロイト{02}の有力諸侯や教皇庁に金をばらまき、
独立をうやむやのうちに承認させてしまう。

 {03}アスロイト王国{02}との関係は今でもやはり悪く、
{03}バイレステ共和国側寄{02}りの外交をとっている。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Duchy of Fakolz

A nation to the west of the Kingdom of Asroit.
Like Asroit, it centers on agriculture. Its
history is short, and the circumstances of its
birth somewhat unusual.

Two hundred years ago, the King of Asroit of
the day gave this region as a present to a
favorite page. After that king's death, his son,
newly seated on the throne, naturally demanded
the return of the territory from the page, but
the page was no mere pretty boy. Bold as he
was, he ignored the demand and made the
region independent as the Duchy of Fakolz. The
new King of Asroit was naturally furious, but
the Duke of Fakolz, who knew the human heart
through and through, scattered money among
Asroit's powerful lords and the Holy See, and
had the independence recognized before anyone
quite knew what had happened.

Relations with the Kingdom of Asroit remain
poor even today, and its diplomacy leans toward
the Republic of Baileste.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}ラコース王国

 大陸の西に位置する国。国の北部は農業が、
南部は商業が盛んで、南部の沿岸都市にはバイ
レステ商人の姿も多い。
 国の歴史は大陸で最も古いが、この数百年間
は、まるでバイレステ共和国の属州のようにな
ってしまっている。
 現国王は、大バイレステ市の繁栄ぶりに対す
る憧れが強く、バイレステで流行の歌劇や音曲
を招き、国庫を浪費させているという。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kingdom of Racoss

A nation in the west of the continent.
Agriculture thrives in the north and commerce
in the south, and Bailestean merchants are a
common sight in the southern coastal cities.
The nation's history is the oldest on the
continent, but for the past several centuries it
has become much like a province of the Republic
of Baileste. The present king is said to hold a
strong admiration for the prosperity of the
city of Great Baileste, and to drain the
treasury by bringing in the operas and music in
fashion in Baileste.{0b:07}

strings.jp: トラドア王国
strings.read: トラドア王国
strings.en: Kingdom of Tradoa
strings.tl: Kingdom of Tradoa

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}トラドア王国

 大陸の最西端に位置する国。気候は温暖だが、
降水量は少なく、痩せた大地の広がる貧しい国
である。
 バイレステの商業圏・文化圏から外れている
ため商工業も遅れているが、これが幸いしてか、
王朝の退廃はさほど顕著ではない。
 アノイア教の中心地レノスから遠く離れてい
るため、アノイア教誕生以前の竜信仰がアノイ
ア教と融合して残っていたり、預言者アノイア
以上に十三聖者に対する信仰が強かったりと、
宗教文化の面でも特徴は多い。
 純朴で陽気、信仰心の篤さがトラドア人の特
徴であろうか。だが熱しやすい国民性が災いし、
他の国では4世紀以上行われていない「神聖裁
判」が未だに行われているのは残念な点である。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kingdom of Tradoa

A nation at the far western edge of the
continent. The climate is mild but rainfall is
scarce, and it is a poor nation of wide, barren
lands. Lying outside the commercial and cultural
sphere of Baileste, its commerce and industry
lag behind, but perhaps thanks to this, the
decadence of the court is not very marked.
Being far from Lenos, the center of the
Anoian faith, it has many distinctive features in
its religious culture as well: the dragon worship
that predates the Anoian faith survives fused
with it, and faith in the Thirteen Saints is
stronger even than faith in the Prophet Anoia.
Simple, cheerful and devout: such, perhaps, are
the traits of the Tradoan people. But
regrettably, their excitable national character
has led them to still hold "Holy Tribunals", which
have not been held in other nations for more
than 4 centuries.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}フィサーノ都市国家連合

 12の都市国家が集まって出来た都市国家連
合。連合の盟主フィサーノ共和国は、かつては
4世紀以上もバイレステ共和国とリガレア海の
覇権を争っていたライバルであった。
 バイレステ共和国と同じく、小さな寒村から
一大商業圏をもつ大国へと成長したフィサーノ
共和国は、同時期に急速に台頭してきたバイレ
ステ共和国とぶつかることとなる。
 当初はフィサーノ共和国が優勢であったが、
勝ちに気をよくしたフィサーノの商人達は、虫
の息のバイレステ共和国を叩かずに、自国内で
勢力争いをはじめる。バイレステ共和国はこの
隙に力を取り戻し、ついに逆転するに至る。
 一時は衰退の一途をたどるだけのフィサーノ
共和国であったが、それから数世紀を経た今、
領土こそ増えていないものの、個々の商人の中
にはバイレステの大商人を脅かすほどの力を得
た者さえ少なくない。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Fisano City-State League

A league of 12 city-states. The Republic of
Fisano, head of the league, was once a rival
that fought the Republic of Baileste for more
than 4 centuries for mastery of the Rigalean
Sea. Like Baileste, the Republic of Fisano grew
from a small, poor village into a great power
with a vast commercial sphere, and it came into
collision with the Republic of Baileste, which
was rising rapidly at the same time. At first
the Republic of Fisano held the advantage, but
the Fisano merchants, pleased with their
victories, began fighting among themselves for
power instead of finishing off the half-dead
Republic of Baileste. The Republic of Baileste
used this opening to regain its strength and at
last turned the tables. For a time the Republic
of Fisano did nothing but decline, but now,
several centuries on, though its territory has
not grown, not a few of its individual
merchants have gained enough power to
threaten even the great merchants of
Baileste.{0b:07}

The Republic of Fisano, head of the league, was once a rival that fought the Republic of Baileste for more than 4 centuries for mastery of the Rigalean Sea. Like Baileste, the Republic of Fisano grew from a small, poor village into a great power with a vast commercial sphere, and it came into collision with the Republic of Baileste, which was rising rapidly at the same time. At first the Republic of Fisano held the advantage, but the Fisano merchants, pleased with their victories, began fighting among themselves for power instead of finishing off the half-dead Republic of Baileste. The Republic of Baileste used this opening to regain its strength and at last turned the tables. For a time the Republic of Fisano did nothing but decline, but now, several centuries on, though its territory has not grown, not a few of its individual merchants have gained enough power to threaten even the great merchants of Baileste.

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kingdom of Irenia

A dynasty that has ruled the island of Irenia in
the Rigalean Sea for more than a thousand
years. At present the northern part of the
island is a province of the Republic of Baileste,
but the kingdom's government does as the
Republic tells it, and the people of the north
suffer under Baileste's exploitation. It is a
beautiful nation of blue seas, warm and rich in
seafood. In recent years the movement for
independence from the Republic of Baileste has
grown fiercer, and many bloody incidents have
taken place, with Baileste as their stage.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}教皇領(レノス教皇領)

 アノイア教会の最高権力者であり、「神の代
理人」と呼ばれる教皇が直接支配する直轄領。
その中心は教皇庁と大小合わせ240もの教会
を抱えた聖地レノス。
 レノスはアノイア教の聖地であると同時に、
大バイレステ、ガスニッツと並ぶ巨大都市であ
る。町の歴史も古く、今から5千年前にはレノ
ス帝国という大陸全土を支配する大帝国の首都
でもあった。
 教皇や枢機卿らアノイア教会の首脳陣は、こ
の歴史ある聖地で日々、陰謀を巡らし教会内の
勢力争いを繰り広げている。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Papal State (Papal State of Lenos)

The domain ruled directly by the Pope, the
supreme authority of the Anoian Church, who is
called the "Vicar of God". At its heart lies the
holy city of Lenos, home to the Holy See and to
240 churches great and small. Lenos is the holy
city of the Anoian faith and at the same time a
vast metropolis, on a par with Great Baileste
and Gasnitz. Its history is long as well: five
thousand years ago it was the capital of the
Lenos Empire, a great empire that ruled the
entire continent. In this historic holy city, the
Pope, the cardinals and the other leaders of
the Anoian Church spend their days weaving
plots and waging power struggles within the
Church.{0b:07}

軍隊などには見向きもせず、軍の高官の肩書き
は、富を持つ貴族や商人に金で売られていた。
 その結果、実戦経験の全くない将軍・提督や、
部下の{01}1人{02}もいない千騎長などが生まれ、聖騎
士などの称号も、人々からは嘲笑の的となって
いたのである。
 ある戯曲作家は、軍隊を「何の取り柄もない
貴族の{03}バカ息子達{02}の溜まり場」と表現していた。
これが軍隊に対しての庶民の認識なのであろう。

 近年起こった戦争として、{01}2百年{02}ほど前に
{03}アスロイト王国{02}と{03}ファコルツ公国間{02}でおこった
「{01}7月戦争{02}」の名前が挙げられる。
 両国の騎士で実際に参戦したものはたったの
{01}5{03}パーセント{02}で、殆どの騎士がなんらかの理由
をつくって出兵を拒否した。両国の動員兵力の
{01}9割{02}がまともに剣も扱えない臨時徴収の農民兵
で、軍隊として機能しているのは傭兵として参
加したごろつき達だけであった。
 この戦争の結末もこの時代を象徴するにふさ
わしく、両軍あわせて{01}3万人{02}が対峙したのにか
かわらず戦死者{01}15名{02}。
 それも、乗り慣れない馬から落馬した、宿営
中の賭博の{03}トラブル{02}などというたわいもない原
因のみである。
 結局、外交交渉であっけなく解決したこの戦
争は、軍隊の無力さを再確認するだけで全く無
為に終わった。

 「{01}7月戦争{02}」から{01}2百年{02}、軍の形骸化はさら
に進行している。このような無力な軍隊で魔物
達の恐怖を防ぐことが不可能なことは、誰の目
から見ても明らかであった。
 {03}アノイア暦{01}5063年12月{02}、魔物が人里ま
でおりてきた時、充分ではないにせよ戦力とし
て役に立ったのは、市民達や農民達の結成した
自警団や、都会の堕落をしらない辺境の地方豪
族のみであった。

 このことは、{03}カルス・バスティード{02}を訪れる
人々の出身を見てもわかるだろう。彼等の殆ど
が、数百・数千年以上も抑圧され、支配され続
けてきた階級の人達なのだから。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}National Armies

Though small conflicts never ceased entirely,
nearly a thousand years of peace turned the
armies of every nation, not only those of the
two great powers, the Kingdom of Asroit and
the Republic of Baileste, into hollow preserves
of the aristocracy. Men of ability paid no heed
to armies with no wars to fight and no
prospect of advancement, and high military
titles were sold for money to wealthy nobles
and merchants. The result was generals and
admirals with no experience of battle, and
commanders of a thousand horse without a
single subordinate, while titles such as paladin
became objects of public ridicule. One playwright
described the army as "a gathering place for
the idiot sons of nobles with nothing to
recommend them". This, no doubt, is how the
common people see the military.

Of the wars of recent times, one may name
the "July War", fought some two hundred years
ago between the Kingdom of Asroit and the
Duchy of Fakolz. Only five percent of the two
countries' knights actually took the field; most
invented some excuse to refuse. Nine-tenths
of the forces mobilized on both sides were
peasants, conscripted for the occasion, who
could barely handle a sword, and the only men
who functioned as an army were the ruffians
who joined as mercenaries. The war's outcome
was a fitting symbol of the age: though thirty
thousand men faced one another across the
two armies, the dead numbered fifteen. Even
those died of such trifling causes as falling
from horses they were not used to riding, and
quarrels over gambling in camp. In the end the
war was settled with anticlimactic ease through
diplomatic negotiation, having accomplished
nothing but to reconfirm how powerless armies
were.

In the two hundred years since the "July War",
the armies have decayed still further. It was
plain to all that such powerless armies could not
hold off the terror of the monsters. In
December of Anoian year 5063, when monsters
came down to human settlements, the only
forces of any use, inadequate as they were,
were the vigilante bands formed by townsfolk
and peasants, and the provincial clan lords of
the frontier, who knew nothing of the cities'
decadence.

This can be seen from the origins of the people
who come to Kars Bastide. Almost all of them
belong to classes that have been oppressed
and ruled for hundreds, even thousands of
years.{0b:07}

Only five percent of the two countries' knights actually took the field; most invented some excuse to refuse. strings.jp: 国民性
strings.read: 国民性
strings.en: National Character
strings.tl: National Character

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}国民性

 農耕文化の北側の国々と商業文化の南側の国
々では、その国民性にも大きな差がある。
 アスロイト王国・ファコルツ公国・ビアスト
ク王国などの北側の国では、平民と貴族の身分
の差は果てしなく大きく、平民の大部分を占め
る農民は、領主や教会の搾取によって常に貧し
い生活を送っている。このため、北側の国々に
は素朴でねばり強い人々が多いといえよう。

 これに対して、バイレステ共和国をはじめと
する南側の国々には、陽気で社交的な人々が多
い。また、貴族・上級市民・平民などの身分の
差は依然強いものの、交易商人であれ職人であ
れ船乗りであれ、生まれ育ちに関係なく才能に
よって成功する可能性が彼等にはまだ残されて
いる。このため、個人主義的な思考が北側の人
々に比べ強いと言えるかもしれない。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}National Character

The agricultural countries of the north and the
mercantile countries of the south differ
greatly in national character as well. In northern
countries such as the Kingdom of Asroit, the
Duchy of Fakolz and the Kingdom of Biastok,
the gulf between commoner and noble is
boundless, and the peasants, who make up most
of the commoners, live in constant poverty,
exploited by their lords and the Church. The
north may thus be said to have many simple,
tenacious people.

The southern countries, led by the Republic of
Baileste, have by contrast many cheerful,
sociable people. And though the divisions of
station between noble, upper citizen and
commoner remain strong, traders, craftsmen
and sailors alike still have the chance to
succeed through talent, regardless of birth and
upbringing. For this reason, it may be said, their
thinking tends to be more individualistic than
that of northerners.{0b:07}
strings.tl:
National Character

The agricultural countries of the north and the mercantile countries of the south differ greatly in national character as well. In northern countries such as the Kingdom of Asroit, the Duchy of Fakolz and the Kingdom of Biastok, the gulf between commoner and noble is boundless, and the peasants, who make up most of the commoners, live in constant poverty, exploited by their lords and the Church. The north may thus be said to have many simple, tenacious people.

The southern countries, led by the Republic of Baileste, have by contrast many cheerful, sociable people. And though the divisions of station between noble, upper citizen and commoner remain strong, traders, craftsmen and sailors alike still have the chance to succeed through talent, regardless of birth and upbringing. For this reason, it may be said, their thinking tends to be more individualistic than that of northerners.

strings.jp: 魔法とは
strings.read: 魔法とは
strings.en: What Is Magic?
strings.tl: What Is Magic?

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}魔法とは

 半世紀前まで、我々の世界に「魔法」という
ものは存在しなかった。いや、かつては存在し
たかもしれないが、地下遺跡の探索がおこなわ
れるまで、人々は「魔法」という技術の存在を
忘れていた、そう言った方が適切なのかもしれ
ない。

 アスラ・ファエルの地下遺跡には、多種多様
な宝物と共に、太古の技術や知識の手がかりも
多数残っていた。そして、その中の幾つかは明
らかに現代のそれよりも優れていたのである。
 「魔法」と我々が呼ぶものも、単に我々の知
識、現代の科学力では理解出来ない、単純な技
術の断片にすぎないのかもしれない。

 地下遺跡の発見から10年もの間、人々は、
「魔法」に対して全くの無関心であった。遺跡
の発見当時は魔法具の使い方を誰も知らず、偶
然それが分かったのちも、魔法が誤射されたり、
必要な時に出ないなど、とても実戦で使える代
物ではなかったからである。

 しかし、地下遺跡の研究のために徐々に学者
達がこの町を訪れるようになるに連れ、次第に
魔法の仕組みも解明されていく。
 屈強な戦士達に混じり危険な地下遺跡を進む
彼らの姿は、初めこそ奇異なものに見えたが、
数年でそれは当たり前の光景となった。財宝目
当ての戦士達にとって、彼らの知識は頼りにな
るコンパスであったし、彼らの研究の成果であ
る「魔法」は、時に熟練の戦士の持つ剣以上の
働きをすることもあったからである。

 こうした先輩研究者の研究のおかげで、加速
度的に「魔法」と「魔法使い」は冒険者達にと
って必要不可欠な存在となっていく。
 今では、戦うための手段として剣の代わりに
魔法を覚える冒険者も少なくないし、様々な国
や組織が、この平和な時代に、魔法具の獲得に
乗り出しているそうである。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}What Is Magic?

Until half a century ago, there was no such
thing as "magic" in our world. No; perhaps it did
exist once, and it would be more accurate to
say that until the underground ruins were
explored, people had forgotten that the
technique called "magic" existed at all.

The underground ruins of Asla Fael held, along
with treasures of every kind, many clues to
ancient techniques and knowledge. And some of
these were clearly superior to those of today.
What we call "magic" may be merely a fragment
of some simple technique that our knowledge
and present-day science cannot comprehend.

For ten years after the discovery of the
underground ruins, people took no interest
whatever in "magic". When the ruins were
discovered, no one knew how to use a Magic
Tool, and even after this was learned by
chance, spells would misfire or fail to come
when needed; it was hardly fit for real combat.

However, as scholars gradually began to come
to this town to study the underground ruins,
the workings of magic were little by little made
clear. The sight of them advancing through the
dangerous underground ruins among stalwart
warriors seemed strange at first, but within a
few years it had become commonplace. To
warriors after treasure, their knowledge was a
dependable compass, and "magic", the fruit of
their research, could at times do more than the
sword of a veteran warrior.

Thanks to the research of these pioneers,
"magic" and "wizards" became, at an
accelerating pace, indispensable to adventurers.
Today not a few adventurers learn magic
instead of the sword as their means of
fighting, and various countries and
organizations, even in this age of peace, are
said to be moving to acquire Magic Tools.{0b:07}

What Is Magic?

Until half a century ago, there was no such thing as "magic" in our world. No; perhaps it did exist once, and it would be more accurate to say that until the underground ruins were explored, people had forgotten that the technique called "magic" existed at all.

The underground ruins of Asla Fael held, along with treasures of every kind, many clues to ancient techniques and knowledge. And some of these were clearly superior to those of today. What we call "magic" may be merely a fragment of some simple technique that our knowledge and present-day science cannot comprehend.

For ten years after the discovery of the underground ruins, people took no interest whatever in "magic". When the ruins were discovered, no one knew how to use a Magic Tool, and even after this was learned by chance, spells would misfire or fail to come when needed; it was hardly fit for real combat.

However, as scholars gradually began to come to this town to study the underground ruins, the workings of magic were little by little made clear. The sight of them advancing through the dangerous underground ruins among stalwart warriors seemed strange at first, but within a few years it had become commonplace. To warriors after treasure, their knowledge was a dependable compass, and "magic", the fruit of their research, could at times do more than the sword of a veteran warrior.

Thanks to the research of these pioneers, "magic" and "wizards" became, at an accelerating pace, indispensable to adventurers. Today not a few adventurers learn magic instead of the sword as their means of fighting, and various countries and organizations, even in this age of peace, are said to be moving to acquire Magic Tools.

strings.jp: 魔法操具について
strings.read: 魔法操具について
strings.en: On Spell Devices
strings.tl: On Spell Devices

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}魔法操具について

 「魔法」を詠唱するには、杖や石版の形をし
た「魔法具」と、刻印のきざまれた腕輪「魔法
操具」という{01}2{02}つの道具が必要となる。

 この{01}2{02}つを装備し、炎が相手を燃やし尽くす
などの{03}イメージ{02}を「思念」として「魔法具」に
送ることで、魔法が具現化される。

 「魔法操具」には、「魔法具」を扱うための
鍵としての役割があり、唱える魔法ごとに別の
刻印が必要となる。この鍵と{03}イメージ{02}が一致す
ると魔法が具現化されるのである。

 どの「魔法操具」も{01}1{02}つの刻印しか表面には
あらわれていないが、実際には複数の刻印が隠
されているのではないかと推察される。

 {01}-補足(著者注)-
 5097年{02}、隠れている刻印を浮かび上がら
せる装置の試作機が完成した。ただし、幾度の
改良を重ねてみたものの、刻印を復活させた
「魔法操具」には、他人に受け渡しが出来ない、
{01}1度手{02}にすれば{01}2度{02}と他の魔法操具を持つこと
は出来ないなどの制約が発生してしまった。{0b:07}

などの{03}イメージ{02}を「思念」として「魔法具」に
送ることで、魔法が具現化される。

 「魔法操具」には、「魔法具」を扱うための
鍵としての役割があり、唱える魔法ごとに別の
刻印が必要となる。この鍵と{03}イメージ{02}が一致す
ると魔法が具現化されるのである。

 どの「魔法操具」も{01}1{02}つの刻印しか表面には
あらわれていないが、実際には複数の刻印が隠
されているのではないかと推察される。

 {01}-補足(著者注)-
 5097年{02}、隠れている刻印を浮かび上がら
せる装置の試作機が完成した。ただし、幾度の
改良を重ねてみたものの、刻印を復活させた
「魔法操具」には、他人に受け渡しが出来ない、
{01}1度手{02}にすれば{01}2度{02}と他の魔法操具を持つこと
は出来ないなどの制約が発生してしまった。{0b:07}
strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}On Spell Devices

To cast "magic" requires two implements: a
"Magic Tool" in the shape of a staff or tablet,
and a "Spell Device", a bracelet engraved with a
sigil.

When one equips both and sends an image, such
as flames burning an enemy to nothing, into the
"Magic Tool" as a "thought-form", the magic
takes shape.

The "Spell Device" serves as a key for
operating the "Magic Tool", and each spell cast
requires a different sigil. When this key and the
image match, the magic takes shape.

Every "Spell Device" shows only one sigil on its
surface, but it is surmised that several more
sigils lie hidden in it.

-Addendum (Author's Note)-

In 5097, a prototype device was completed
that brings the hidden sigils to the surface.
However, despite repeated improvements, a
"Spell Device" whose sigils have been restored
comes with restrictions: it cannot be handed to
another person, and once one has held it, one
can never again hold any other Spell Device.{0b:07}

strings.jp: 魔法具について
strings.read: 魔法具について
strings.en: On Magic Tools
strings.tl: On Magic Tools

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}魔法具について

 「魔法具」と「魔法操具」の関係は弓と矢の
関係に似ていると指摘した人がいた。これもま
た、的を射た表現であろう。
 さらに詳しく例えるならば、「魔法操具」と
は「思念」を特定の「矢」に変える装置であり、
「魔法具」とは、「思念から生まれた矢」を発
射するための「弓」であると言えよう。

 魔法具には杖の形をしたもの、錫杖(短い杖)
の形をしたもの、石版の形をしたものの3つの
タイプがある。
 杖の形をした魔法具は、炎が相手を燃やし尽
くすなどの「イメージの強さ」によって魔法の
威力が変わり、石版の形をした魔法具は、その
イメージを思い浮かべる時の「論理性の高さ」
によって魔法の強さが変わっていくようである。
錫杖は両方の中間といったところだろうか。

 「魔法具」は基本的に持ち替え自由だが、そ
れによって魔法の種類が変わることはない。
しかし、魔法自体の威力を高めることは可能な
ので、性能のよい魔法具を見つけることも魔法
使いの重要な仕事であろう。

 これ以上のことは残念ながら何も分からない。
著者の持つ石版は、ごくありふれた鉱石で造ら
れているし、石版や杖、魔法操具の中に特殊な
装置が埋め込まれているわけでもない。
 明らかなことと言えば、魔法具と魔法操具が、
術者の精神力を変質・増幅し、様々なエネルギ
ーに変化させる「種と仕掛けのある装置」であ
るということだけだろうか。

 いずれにせよ、魔法とは、無から何かを生み
出す「奇跡」ではない。
 例えば治癒の術は、人間を含めたあらゆる動
物が持つ生命力・自然治癒力に手を貸すにすぎ
ないので、生命の法則を無視したこと、例えば
死者を蘇らせるなどといったことは出来ないし、
定められた使い方以外でこの「装置」を扱って
も、この古代の「装置」は何も生み出さない。

 魔法を盲信せず、それぞれの魔法・魔法具・
魔法操具の特性を正確に理解することが、魔法
使いに必要な姿勢であるといえるだろう。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}On Magic Tools

Someone once pointed out that the relation
between "Magic Tool" and "Spell Device"
resembles that of bow and arrow. This too is
an expression that hits the mark. To carry the
comparison further, a "Spell Device" is an
apparatus that turns a "thought-form" into a
particular "arrow", and a "Magic Tool" is the
"bow" that fires this "arrow born of thought".

Magic Tools come in three types: those shaped
like a staff, those shaped like a sacred staff
(a short staff), and those shaped like a tablet.
With staff-shaped Magic Tools, the power of
the magic varies with the "strength of the
image", such as flames burning an enemy to
nothing; with tablet-shaped ones, it seems to
vary with the "degree of logic" with which that
image is called to mind. The sacred staff,
perhaps, lies midway between the two.

"Magic Tools" can in principle be exchanged
freely, but doing so does not change the kind
of magic. It is, however, possible to heighten
the power of the magic itself, so finding a
Magic Tool of good quality is surely an
important task for a wizard.

Beyond this, regrettably, nothing is known. The
author's own tablet is made of a quite ordinary
ore, and no special mechanism is embedded in
tablets, staffs or Spell Devices. The one thing
that is clear, perhaps, is that Magic Tools and
Spell Devices are "devices with something up
their sleeves", which transform and amplify the
caster's mental power and convert it into
various energies.

In any case, magic is not a "miracle" that
creates something from nothing. The healing
arts, for example, merely lend a hand to the
vitality and natural healing power of all animals,
humans included. So they can do nothing that
ignores the laws of life, such as raising the
dead, and if this "device" is used other than as
prescribed, this ancient "device" produces
nothing.

Not to believe blindly in magic, but to
understand accurately the properties of each
spell, Magic Tool and Spell Device: that, one may
say, is the attitude a wizard needs.{0b:07}
strings.tl:
On Magic Tools

Someone once pointed out that the relation between "Magic Tool" and "Spell Device" resembles that of bow and arrow. This too is an expression that hits the mark. To carry the comparison further, a "Spell Device" is an apparatus that turns a "thought-form" into a particular "arrow", and a "Magic Tool" is the "bow" that fires this "arrow born of thought".

Magic Tools come in three types: those shaped like a staff, those shaped like a sacred staff (a short staff), and those shaped like a tablet. With staff-shaped Magic Tools, the power of the magic varies with the "strength of the image", such as flames burning an enemy to nothing; with tablet-shaped ones, it seems to vary with the "degree of logic" with which that image is called to mind. The sacred staff, perhaps, lies midway between the two.

"Magic Tools" can in principle be exchanged freely, but doing so does not change the kind of magic. It is, however, possible to heighten the power of the magic itself, so finding a Magic Tool of good quality is surely an important task for a wizard.

Beyond this, regrettably, nothing is known. The author's own tablet is made of a quite ordinary ore, and no special mechanism is embedded in tablets, staffs or Spell Devices. The one thing that is clear, perhaps, is that Magic Tools and Spell Devices are "devices with something up their sleeves", which transform and amplify the caster's mental power and convert it into various energies.

In any case, magic is not a "miracle" that creates something from nothing. The healing arts, for example, merely lend a hand to the vitality and natural healing power of all animals, humans included. So they can do nothing that ignores the laws of life, such as raising the dead, and if this "device" is used other than as prescribed, this ancient "device" produces nothing.

Not to believe blindly in magic, but to understand accurately the properties of each spell, Magic Tool and Spell Device: that, one may say, is the attitude a wizard needs.

strings.jp: 太陽帝国の発見
strings.read: 太陽帝国の発見
strings.en: Discovery of the Sun Empire
strings.tl: Discovery of the Sun Empire

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}太陽帝国の発見

 今より遙か昔、突如この世界に現れ、そして
忽然と消えたと伝えられる大帝国。太陽帝国の
名は後世の人々が付けた名である。
 首都は、「永遠の都市」という意味を持つア
スラ・ファエル。他を圧する高度な物質文明と
精神文明をもち、十数年で世界の半分を支配し、
首都アスラ・ファエルの繁栄は天上界の神々が
妬むほどであったと伝えられている。

 過去、太陽帝国の遺跡が発見されたことは
1度としてなく、神話や伝説といった形でその
存在が言い伝えられていたに過ぎなかったため、
半世紀前までこの帝国の実在を信じる学者は
1人としていなかった。
 しかし、地下に広がる巨大な遺跡と、永遠の
命をもたらす「アザレの石」の発見は、おとぎ
話に血生臭い息吹を吹き込むこととなった。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Discovery of the Sun Empire

A great empire said to have appeared suddenly
in this world long, long ago, and then to have
vanished without a trace. The name Sun Empire
is one that later generations gave it. Its capital
was Asla Fael, which means "Eternal City". It
possessed material and spiritual civilizations of
a height that overwhelmed all others, and it is
told that it ruled half the world within little
more than a decade, and that its capital, Asla
Fael, prospered so greatly that the gods of
the heavens envied it.

No ruin of the Sun Empire had ever been found,
and its existence was handed down only in the
form of myth and legend, so until half a
century ago not one scholar believed this
empire had truly existed. But the discovery of
vast ruins spreading underground, and of the
"Azare Stone", which brings eternal life,
breathed a bloody life into the fairy tale.{0b:07}
strings.tl:
Discovery of the Sun Empire

A great empire said to have appeared suddenly in this world long, long ago, and then to have vanished without a trace. The name Sun Empire is one that later generations gave it. Its capital was Asla Fael, which means "Eternal City". It possessed material and spiritual civilizations of a height that overwhelmed all others, and it is told that it ruled half the world within little more than a decade, and that its capital, Asla Fael, prospered so greatly that the gods of the heavens envied it.

No ruin of the Sun Empire had ever been found, and its existence was handed down only in the form of myth and legend, so until half a century ago not one scholar believed this empire had truly existed. But the discovery of vast ruins spreading underground, and of the "Azare Stone", which brings eternal life, breathed a bloody life into the fairy tale.

strings.jp: 文献中の太陽帝国
strings.read: 文献中の太陽帝国
strings.en: The Sun Empire in the Texts
strings.tl: The Sun Empire in the Texts

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}文献中の太陽帝国

 太陽帝国の名は、世界各地の数多くの神話や
伝説に登場するが、その内容にはいくつかの共
通点と相違点がある。
 優れた文明と他を圧倒する軍事力を有し、世
界の半分を支配していたこと、太陽神を信仰し
ていたこと、永遠の生命と永遠の世界を追い求
めていたこと、首都アスラ・ファエルの繁栄ぶ
りなどは、どの神話・伝承でも共通して描かれ
ているが、その所在地や、太陽帝国が滅んだ理
由、そして生命を永遠のものとする技術が完成
したか否かなどについては、記述されている内
容に大きな食い違いがあった。
 太陽帝国が神の国そのものであったと記述し
ているものもあれば、太陽帝国の民が神への信
仰と感謝を忘れたため、神の怒りにふれ滅んだ
とするものもある。
 この二面性が一体何を指すのか、今後の研究
で謎が解けることを期待する。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}The Sun Empire in the Texts

The name of the Sun Empire appears in
numerous myths and legends around the world,
and these agree on some points and differ on
others. That it possessed an advanced
civilization and overwhelming military power and
ruled half the world; that it worshipped a sun
god; that it pursued eternal life and an Eternal
World; the prosperity of its capital, Asla Fael:
all these are described alike in every myth and
tradition. But as to its location, the reason the
Sun Empire fell, and whether the art of making
life eternal was ever perfected, the accounts
differ widely. Some write that the Sun Empire
was the very land of God, while others have it
that its people forgot their faith and gratitude
toward God, and fell to God's wrath. I look
forward to future research solving the riddle
of what this duality signifies.{0b:07}

But as to its location, the reason the Sun Empire fell, and whether the art of making life eternal was ever perfected, the accounts differ widely. Some write that the Sun Empire was the very land of God, while others have it that its people forgot their faith and gratitude toward God, and fell to God's wrath. I look forward to future research solving the riddle of what this duality signifies.

strings.jp: カルス・バスティード
strings.read: カルス・バスティード
strings.en: Kars Bastide
strings.tl: Kars Bastide

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}カルス・バスティード

 二大国が定めた正式名称は「カルス・バステ
ィード」だが、伝説の国・太陽帝国の首都「ア
スラ・ファエル」の名を冠して呼ばれることの
方が多い。バスティードとは、城壁に囲まれた
小規模な城塞都市を指すラコース語。そして、
関係者の多くは、皮肉を込めて「カルスの棺桶」
などとも呼ぶ。

 アスロイト王国とバイレステ共和国の緩衝地
帯であるカルス山脈のちょうど中央にあり、両
国が共同統治している。
 急峻な山の中腹に岩肌をくり抜いたように存
在し、気候は厳しく自然の恵みにも乏しい。本
来ならば人が住むような環境ではないと言える
だろう。

 1年に2度だけ、四重の分厚い鉄門に仕切ら
れた城門が解放され、冒険者達を迎え入れる。
このわずかな間を除いて、城門には外側から閂
と鍵がかけられ、城壁の中と外とを完全に分断
する。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Kars Bastide

The official name set by the two great powers
is "Kars Bastide", but it is more often called
after the capital of the legendary Sun Empire,
"Asla Fael". Bastide is a Racoss word for a
small fortified town surrounded by walls. And
many of those concerned call it, with irony, the
"Coffin of Kars".

It lies at the very center of the Kars
Mountains, the buffer zone between the
Kingdom of Asroit and the Republic of Baileste,
and the two countries govern it jointly. It sits
halfway up a steep mountain, as if hollowed out
of the rock face; the climate is harsh and
nature's gifts are scant. By rights, one may
say, this is no place for people to live.

Just twice a year, the town gate, divided by
four thick iron doors, is opened to welcome
adventurers. Apart from this brief interval, the
gate is barred and locked from the outside,
cutting off the inside of the walls completely
from the outside.{0b:07}
strings.tl:
Kars Bastide

The official name set by the two great powers is "Kars Bastide", but it is more often called after the capital of the legendary Sun Empire, "Asla Fael". Bastide is a Racoss word for a small fortified town surrounded by walls. And many of those concerned call it, with irony, the "Coffin of Kars".

It lies at the very center of the Kars Mountains, the buffer zone between the Kingdom of Asroit and the Republic of Baileste, and the two countries govern it jointly. It sits halfway up a steep mountain, as if hollowed out of the rock face; the climate is harsh and nature's gifts are scant. By rights, one may say, this is no place for people to live.

Just twice a year, the town gate, divided by four thick iron doors, is opened to welcome adventurers. Apart from this brief interval, the gate is barred and locked from the outside, cutting off the inside of the walls completely from the outside.

strings.jp: カルス山脈
strings.read: カルス山脈
strings.en: The Kars Mountains
strings.tl: The Kars Mountains

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}カルス山脈

 アスロイト王国とバイレステ共和国の国境線
として、大陸を東西に横切る大山脈。 
 国が丸ごと収まるほどの広大な面積をもつが、
人が住むにはまるで適さず、領土的にも全く無
価値なため、千年以上も前にアスロイト王国と
バイレステ共和国の緩衝地帯となった。

 緑は殆どなく、見渡す限りの岩や石に覆われ
た不毛の山脈である。さらに、人体に有害な硫
化ガスや炭酸ガスが吹き出す場所もあり、人が
住むには全く適していないため「死の山脈」の
異名をも持つ。
 実際、この広大な山脈全体で、4つの部族、
あわせて数百人が細々と暮らすのみであり、
「アザレの石」が発見されるまで、ここに人が
住んでいることを知っている人さえ少なかった
ほどである。

 カルス山脈と山の民アオゥル族が、世界中の
知るところとなったのは、太陽帝国の首都「ア
スラ・ファエル」の遺跡と、不老不死をもたら
す「アザレの石」を、アオゥル族の老人が偶然
発見したその時からであった。
 4つの部族のうち最も小規模のアオゥル族は、
『アザレの石』のために13人が不老不死とな
り、アスラ・ファエル・バスティードと共にそ
の部族の名も一躍世界中の知るところとなる。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}The Kars Mountains

A great range crossing the continent from
east to west, forming the national border
between the Kingdom of Asroit and the
Republic of Baileste. Its area is vast enough to
hold a whole country, but it is wholly unsuited
to human habitation and wholly worthless as
territory, so more than a thousand years ago it
became a buffer zone between the Kingdom of
Asroit and the Republic of Baileste.

There is almost no greenery; it is a barren
range covered in rock and stone as far as the
eye can see. There are also places where
sulfurous gas and carbonic gas, harmful to the
body, blow forth, and because it is so utterly
unsuited to human life, it is also known as the
"Mountains of Death". Indeed, this whole vast
range holds only four tribes, a few hundred
people in all, eking out a living, and until the
"Azare Stone" was discovered, few even knew
that anyone lived here.

The Kars Mountains and the mountain people,
the Aoul tribe, became known to the whole
world from the moment an old man of the Aoul
happened upon the ruins of "Asla Fael", capital
of the Sun Empire, and the "Azare Stone",
which makes one ageless and undying. The Aoul,
the smallest of the four tribes, had thirteen of
their people made ageless and undying by the
'Azare Stone', and their tribe's name, together
with Asla Fael Bastide, was all at once known
throughout the world.{0b:07}

strings.jp: 気候・環境
strings.read: 気候・環境
strings.en: Climate and Environment
strings.tl: Climate and Environment

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}気候・環境

 カルス・バスティードの気候は過酷だ。カル
ス山脈の中央部は、荒い岩の転がる緑の無い砂
漠地帯である。加えて、この町は山の中腹(標
高3100リーダ)にあるため、空気も薄く、
さらに動植物の住み難い環境となっている。

 夏は非常に乾燥し雨はほとんど期待出来ない。
昼間の気温は40グラドを越えるが、夜は氷点
下まで落ち込む。
 冬は、幸運にも町の中に雪は降らないが、気
温は-20グラドを越えることはない。
 また、ひとたび天気が荒れ始めると、強烈な
豪雨や豪雪がこの町を襲う。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Climate and Environment

The climate of Kars Bastide is harsh. The
central Kars Mountains are a desert without a
trace of green, strewn with rough rock. What is
more, the town stands halfway up a mountain
(at an elevation of 3100 rida), so the air is thin,
making it an even harder environment for
animals and plants.

Summer is extremely dry and rain can hardly be
expected. Daytime temperatures exceed 40
grad, but at night they fall below freezing. In
winter, fortunately, no snow falls inside the
town, but the temperature never rises above
-20 grad. And once the weather turns foul,
ferocious downpours and blizzards strike the
town.{0b:07}
strings.tl:
Climate and Environment

The climate of Kars Bastide is harsh. The central Kars Mountains are a desert without a trace of green, strewn with rough rock. What is more, the town stands halfway up a mountain (at an elevation of 3100 rida), so the air is thin, making it an even harder environment for animals and plants.

Summer is extremely dry and rain can hardly be expected. Daytime temperatures exceed 40 grad, but at night they fall below freezing. In winter, fortunately, no snow falls inside the town, but the temperature never rises above -20 grad. And once the weather turns foul, ferocious downpours and blizzards strike the town.

strings.jp: 食べ物
strings.read: 食べ物
strings.en: Food
strings.tl: Food

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}食べ物

 {03}カルス・バスティード内{02}で自給出来る品物は
ほとんどないため、食糧に限らず、ほぼ全ての
生活必要物資は町の外から送られてくるものに
頼っている。
 {01}1年{02}に{01}2度{02}、{03}カルス山脈{02}の険しい山々を越え
て、{01}1ヶ月{02}がかりで運ばれるその品々は、実際
の値段の数十倍から数万倍の値段が付けられる。
 冒険者達は、{03}アスラ・ファエル{02}で発見される
様々な財宝を交易商人に売り、そして高額な{03}パ
ン{02}や酒を買うのである。
 交易商人が運んでくる食糧は、{03}パン用{02}の{03}ライ
麦、塩漬{02}け肉、{03}チーズ、ワイン{02}など保存のきく
物のみで、新鮮な肉や魚や野菜が冒険者の口に
入ることはほとんどない。
 種類も少なく、品質もお世辞にもいい物とは
言えないが、我々に選ぶ権利はない。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Food

Almost nothing can be produced within Kars
Bastide itself, so not just food but nearly all
the necessities of life depend on what is sent
from outside the town. Brought over the steep
peaks of the Kars Mountains twice a year, on a
journey of a month, these goods are priced at
dozens to tens of thousands of times their
real value. Adventurers sell the many treasures
found in Asla Fael to traders, then buy costly
bread and liquor. The food the traders bring is
only what keeps: rye for bread, salted meat,
cheese and wine. Fresh meat, fish and
vegetables scarcely ever reach an adventurer's
mouth. There is little variety, and even flattery
could not call the quality good, but we have no
right to choose.{0b:07}

Fresh meat, fish and vegetables scarcely ever reach an adventurer's mouth. There is little variety, and even flattery could not call the quality good, but we have no right to choose.

strings.jp: 交易商人
strings.read: 交易商人
strings.en: Traders
strings.tl: Traders

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}交易商人

 カルス・バスティードと外の世界とを結ぶ商
人達。冒険者達から地下遺跡で見つかった財宝
を買い取り、彼等に日用品を法外な値段で売る。
 と言っても、別に道義に反する商売をしてい
るわけではない。城壁の内側にいる商人(つま
りオイゲン氏のことですね)は、閉ざされた町
の中で魔物の恐怖を感じながら日々を送らねば
ならないし、彼等が相手しなければならない冒
険者の中には荒くれ男も少なくない。
 城壁の外側の商人は、カルス山脈の険しく危
険な尾根を1ヶ月近くもかけて行き来しなけれ
ばならないし、ランツの町付近にはこの財宝目
当ての山賊までもが出没するようになった。
 そして何よりも、アスラ・ファエルの財宝を
扱う商人達は、アスロイト王国とバイレステ共
和国の二国に多額の税とリベートを納めなけれ
ばならないのである。パン1個の値段が庶民の
1ヶ月の生活費までになるのはこのためだ。
 交易商人も、ハイリスクハイリターンの点で
は冒険者と何ら変わりない。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Traders

The merchants who link Kars Bastide with the
outside world. They buy from adventurers the
treasures found in the underground ruins, and
sell them daily goods at outrageous prices. That
said, their trade is by no means an immoral one.
The merchant inside the walls (meaning
Eugen-san, of course) must spend his days in a
closed town, feeling the terror of the
monsters, and not a few of the adventurers he
must deal with are ruffians. The merchants
outside the walls must spend nearly a month
traversing the steep, dangerous ridges of the
Kars Mountains, and near the town of Lanz
even bandits have begun to appear, after this
very treasure. Above all, merchants dealing in
the treasures of Asla Fael must pay heavy
taxes and rebates to both the Kingdom of
Asroit and the Republic of Baileste. That is
why a single loaf of bread costs as much as a
commoner's living for a month. In high risk and
high return, traders are no different from
adventurers.{0b:07}

The merchants outside the walls must spend nearly a month traversing the steep, dangerous ridges of the Kars Mountains, and near the town of Lanz even bandits have begun to appear, after this very treasure. Above all, merchants dealing in the treasures of Asla Fael must pay heavy taxes and rebates to both the Kingdom of Asroit and the Republic of Baileste. That is why a single loaf of bread costs as much as a commoner's living for a month. In high risk and high return, traders are no different from adventurers.

strings.jp: 城門と城壁
strings.read: 城門と城壁
strings.en: Gate and Walls
strings.tl: Gate and Walls

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}城門と城壁

 {03}カルス・バスティード{02}の城門は、四重の分厚
い鉄扉に仕切られ、町の外側から閂と鍵がかけ
られている。

 この鉄扉や鍵や閂には、地下遺跡内{01}(黒{02}の羨
道内{01}){02}で実際に使用されていたものがそのまま
使用された。
 これらに使用されている金属は我々の扱う金
属とは全く違うものらしく、酸化することもな
く、強度も鋼などとは比較にならないほど強い。
どんな武器や爆発物でも傷{01}1{02}つ付けることがで
きない上、あらゆる属性の魔法を吸収してしま
うので、魔物を閉じこめるにはまさに打ってつ
けの部品であると言えよう。

 {01}1年{02}に{01}2回{02}、{03}ゼメン{02}の日と{03}ゼウェアク{02}の日に
のみ、約{01}1時間{02}だけこの鉄扉は開く。
 {01}4{02}つの扉のうち{01}2{02}つは、どのような仕組みで
そうなっているのかは分からないが、この日に
自動的に開くようになっているようだ。
 {01}1万年前{02}に滅んだ太陽帝国の遺物が、{01}5千年
前{02}に誕生した{03}アノイア教{02}の最重要祝祭日と同日
に作動するのは奇妙な符合であるが、これによ
り、太陽帝国の一部では{03}アノイア教{02}と同じ太陰
暦が用いられていたことが推察される。

 残る{01}2枚{02}の扉の鍵は、{03}ランツ{02}に駐在する{03}アス
ロイト王国{02}と{03}バイレステ共和国{02}の{01}2人{02}の総督が
それぞれ{01}1{02}つずつ管理している。
 当然ながら、鍵を揃えても定められた日以外
は、城門を抜けることは出来ない。また、定め
られた日であっても、鍵が{01}1{02}つでも欠ければ城
門を抜けることは出来ない。

 この城門がこの町の唯一の入り口である。城
壁はさほど高くはないが、城壁の内側の壁には
遺跡の中で見つかった「結界石」と呼ばれる石
が等間隔に置かれ、登ろうとする人間を一瞬の
うちに死に至らしめるので、城壁を越えるのは
まず不可能だ。また、足下は固い岩盤で{03}トンネ
ル{02}を掘ることも出来ない。
 この町の城門と城壁は、魔物を閉じこめるた
めの檻としても、冒険者を閉じこめる棺桶とし
てもまさに完璧な建造物であると言えよう。{0b:07}

 当然ながら、鍵を揃えても定められた日以外
は、城門を抜けることは出来ない。また、定め
られた日であっても、鍵が{01}1{02}つでも欠ければ城
門を抜けることは出来ない。

 この城門がこの町の唯一の入り口である。城
壁はさほど高くはないが、城壁の内側の壁には
遺跡の中で見つかった「結界石」と呼ばれる石
が等間隔に置かれ、登ろうとする人間を一瞬の
うちに死に至らしめるので、城壁を越えるのは
まず不可能だ。また、足下は固い岩盤で{03}トンネ
ル{02}を掘ることも出来ない。
 この町の城門と城壁は、魔物を閉じこめるた
めの檻としても、冒険者を閉じこめる棺桶とし
てもまさに完璧な建造物であると言えよう。{0b:07}
strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Gate and Walls

The gate of Kars Bastide is divided by four
thick iron doors, barred and locked from outside
the town.

These iron doors, locks and bars are the very
ones that were in use inside the underground
ruins (within the Black Passage). The metal in
them appears to be quite unlike the metals we
work with: it does not oxidize, and its strength
is beyond comparison with steel. No weapon or
explosive can leave so much as a scratch on it,
and it absorbs magic of every element, making
these the perfect components for confining
monsters.

Twice a year, only on Zemen's Day and
Zeweak's Day, these iron doors open for about
an hour. Two of the four doors, by what
mechanism is unknown, seem to open
automatically on these days. It is an odd
coincidence that a relic of the Sun Empire,
which fell ten thousand years ago, should
operate on the same days as the most
important festivals of the Anoian faith, born
five thousand years ago; from this it may be
inferred that parts of the Sun Empire used the
same lunar calendar as the Anoian faith.

The keys to the remaining two doors are held
one each by the two governors stationed in
Lanz, one for the Kingdom of Asroit and one
for the Republic of Baileste. Naturally, even
with both keys, no one can pass through the
gate except on the appointed days. And even
on the appointed days, no one can pass through
if a single key is missing.

This gate is the sole entrance to the town.
The walls are not very high, but along their
inner face, stones found in the ruins, called
"Ward Stones", are placed at regular intervals,
and they kill in an instant anyone who tries to
climb, so crossing the walls is next to impossible.
And the ground underfoot is hard bedrock, in
which no tunnel can be dug. The gate and walls
of this town are truly perfect structures,
both as a cage to confine monsters and as a
coffin to confine adventurers.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}{03}アオゥル族

 カルス山脈{02}に住む、{03}ヤク{02}の放牧で細々と暮ら
す少数山岳民族。
 {03}アノイア暦{01}5060年1月3日{02}、{03}カルス山脈
中央部{02}を襲った大地震の後、{03}アオゥル族{02}の{01}1人
{02}の老人がこの地で奇妙な光る石と見慣れない幾
つかの装飾品を発見する。
 この偶然により、太陽帝国の首都{03}アスラ・フ
ァエル{02}の発掘は始まった。そして、このことは
彼等の運命をも一変させる。

 {03}アオゥル族{02}の{01}13人{02}の男女が「{03}アザレ{02}の石」
の光を浴び不老不死となる。このことは彼等に
とって決して祝福すべき出来事ではなかった。
 {03}アスロイト王国{02}と{03}バイレステ共和国{02}の二大国
は彼等を、{03}カルス・バスティード{02}への険しい山
道の案内や物資の運搬で、地下遺跡の発掘で、
魔物が出現してのちは城壁の建設などで使役し
続けた。
 彼等はいつも危険な場所をまかされ、牛馬の
ごとく働かされた。その過酷さは、彼等に「死
なない・死ねない体」になったことを後悔させ
るに充分であったという。
 もちろん、その背景には、不老不死になった
彼等に対する人々の「妬み」があったことは否
定出来ない。
 不老不死となった{01}13人{02}の{03}アオゥル族{02}のうち、
消息の明らかなのは僅かに{01}2人{02}。残りの{01}11人
{02}が今どこで何をやっているのかは誰も知らない。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}The Aoul Tribe

A small mountain people of the Kars Mountains
who eke out a living herding yaks. On January 3
of Anoian year 5060, after a great earthquake
struck the central Kars Mountains, an old man
of the Aoul discovered there a strange glowing
stone and several unfamiliar ornaments. This
chance find began the excavation of Asla Fael,
capital of the Sun Empire. And it changed the
fate of his people as well.

Thirteen men and women of the Aoul bathed in
the light of the "Azare Stone" and became
ageless and undying. For them this was by no
means an event to celebrate. The two great
powers, the Kingdom of Asroit and the Republic
of Baileste, kept them in forced labor: guiding
travelers along the steep mountain road to
Kars Bastide and hauling supplies, excavating
the underground ruins, and, after the monsters
appeared, building the walls. They were always
given the dangerous places and worked like oxen
and horses. The harshness of it, they say, was
enough to make them regret having gained a
body that "does not die and cannot die". Behind
this, of course, it cannot be denied, lay people's
"envy" of them for having become ageless and
undying. Of the thirteen undying Aoul, the
whereabouts of only two are known. No one
knows where the other eleven are or what they
are doing now.{0b:07}

On January 3 of Anoian year 5060, after a great earthquake struck the central Kars Mountains, an old man of the Aoul discovered there a strange glowing stone and several unfamiliar ornaments. This chance find began the excavation of Asla Fael, capital of the Sun Empire. And it changed the fate of his people as well.

Thirteen men and women of the Aoul bathed in the light of the "Azare Stone" and became ageless and undying. For them this was by no means an event to celebrate. The two great powers, the Kingdom of Asroit and the Republic of Baileste, kept them in forced labor: guiding travelers along the steep mountain road to Kars Bastide and hauling supplies, excavating the underground ruins, and, after the monsters appeared, building the walls. They were always given the dangerous places and worked like oxen and horses. The harshness of it, they say, was enough to make them regret having gained a body that "does not die and cannot die". Behind this, of course, it cannot be denied, lay people's "envy" of them for having become ageless and undying. Of the thirteen undying Aoul, the whereabouts of only two are known. No one knows where the other eleven are or what they are doing now.

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}ランツの町

 カルス・バスティードの西に位置する小さな
町。カルス・バスティードから最も近い町であ
るが、距離にして約4千リーダもあり、しかも
行程のほとんどが険しい山道のため、片道だけ
で1ヶ月近くもかかってしまう。

 カルス・バスティードが発見される前は、木
材や木炭を扱うバイレステ商人が夏の間だけ住
む人口100人程度の静かな町であったが、ア
スラ・ファエルが発見されてからは世界中から
多くの商人が集まる活気のある町となった。

 ランツの町とカルス・バスティード間の物資
の輸送は、2ヶ月もかけて山道を往復するか、
両方の町に設置されている「転送器」を利用す
るかのいずれかの方法しかない。

 転送器は一瞬で物資を送ることの出来る便利
な装置であるが、送れるものは経年劣化しない
ものに限られているため、結局、大半の物資は
人間の手によって運ばなければならない。
 往復2ヶ月の物資輸送には、莫大な人件費が
かかるのだが、それでも商人達にとって、アス
ラ・ファエルの財宝を扱うことはかなり旨味の
ある商売に分類されるそうである。

 ランツの町は本来バイレステ共和国領である
が、現在はこの町もカルス・バスティードと同
じくアスロイト王国との共同統治となっている。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}The Town of Lanz

A small town to the west of Kars Bastide. It is
the nearest town to Kars Bastide, yet some
4000 rida away, and as most of the way is
steep mountain road, it takes nearly a month
one way.

Before Kars Bastide was discovered, it was a
quiet town of about 100 people, where
Bailestean merchants dealing in timber and
charcoal lived only in summer; but since the
discovery of Asla Fael it has become a lively
town where merchants gather from around the
world.

Goods can move between Lanz and Kars
Bastide in only two ways: by traveling the
mountain road for two months round trip, or by
using the "Transporters" installed in both
towns.

A Transporter is a convenient device that can
send goods in an instant, but it can send only
things that do not deteriorate with age, so
most goods must still be carried by human
hands in the end. The two-month round trip
costs an enormous sum in labor, yet even so,
handling the treasures of Asla Fael is said to
rank among merchants as a rather lucrative
trade.

The town of Lanz was originally territory of
the Republic of Baileste, but now it, like Kars
Bastide, is under joint rule with the Kingdom of
Asroit.{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}Foreword

This book is an essay written to take a fresh
look, as one "philosophy", at the Anoian faith,
which has so melted into our values and even
our daily lives as to be inseparable from them.
However, since the author too is an Anoian
believer, if not a very devout one, some parts
may lack objectivity. Please bear with this.

strings.en: What Is the Anoian Faith?

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}{03}アノイア教{02}とは

 預言者{03}アノイア{02}と十三聖者による成立から
{01}5千年{02}、各地の土着の神々を吸収・排除し、
現在ではこの大陸の{01}99{03}パーセント{02}の人々に信
仰される、文字通り世界最大の宗教、それが{03}ア
ノイア教{02}である。

 {03}アノイア教{02}の教義の最大の特徴は、特殊な二
元論・二神論にある。
 太陽と光の神「{03}ゼメン」{02}と、月と闇の神「{03}ゼ
ウェアク」{02}の二至高神がこの世界の全てを創造
し、この二至高神と神の御子{03}アノイア{02}への信仰
を持つ者だけが、永遠なる神の世界「新しい世
界」に入ることが出来る、というのが教義の骨
子である。
 それまでの宗教と大きく異なる点は、二元論
的な教義であるにも関わらず、{03}ゼメン{02}と{03}ゼウェ
アク{02}の二至高神は対立する存在ではなく、片方
が「善」で片方が「悪」という訳ではない点に
あるのではないだろうか。この二至高神は同格
の神であり、双方ともに最高の信仰の対象なの
である。
 光は生命に活力をもたらし、闇は静寂ととも
に安らぎをもたらす。光と闇、活力と安らぎ、
変化と持続、肉体と精神・・・双方が「対立」
ではなく「調和」し、均等な力で存在すること
こそが、この世界の正しい姿であり真理だと聖
書は説いている。

 そして、聖書中での究極の理想世界である、
永遠なる神の国「新しい世界」は、これらの要
素が完全に調和した状態、つまり、肉体と霊魂
などの境界が全てなくなり、二至高神を含めた
この世界の全てが{01}1{02}つに融合する世界を指して
いる。
 そこには、一切の悩みや苦しみが存在しない
と聖書は説く。圧制や重税に苦しむ民衆にとっ
て、二至高神や預言者よりも、この「新しい世
界」こそが信仰の対象なのかもしれない。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}What Is the Anoian Faith?

Five thousand years after its founding by the
Prophet Anoia and the Thirteen Saints, having
absorbed or cast out the native gods of every
land, the Anoian faith is now held by 99 percent
of the people of this continent: literally the
largest religion in the world.

The chief feature of Anoian doctrine lies in its
peculiar dualism and two-god system. The core
of the doctrine is this: the Two Supreme Gods,
Zemen, god of sun and light, and Zeweak, god
of moon and darkness, created all things in this
world, and only those who hold faith in these
Two Supreme Gods and in Anoia, Child of God,
may enter the "New World", the eternal world
of God. Where it differs greatly from earlier
religions, perhaps, is that despite its dualist
doctrine, Zemen and Zeweak are not opposed
beings: one is not "good" and the other "evil".
These Two Supreme Gods are of equal rank,
and both are the highest objects of faith.

rest along with stillness. Light and dark, vigor
and rest, change and permanence, body and
spirit... That each pair exists not in "opposition"
but in "harmony", with equal power, is the
proper state of this world and its truth, the
Scriptures teach.

And the Scriptures' ultimate ideal world, the
"New World", God's eternal kingdom, is a state
in which these elements are in perfect harmony;
that is, all boundaries, such as those between
flesh and soul, vanish, and everything in this
world, the Two Supreme Gods included, fuses
into one. There, the Scriptures teach, no
trouble or suffering exists at all. For a
populace suffering under tyranny and heavy
taxes, perhaps this "New World", more than the
Two Supreme Gods or the Prophet, is the true
object of faith.{0b:07}

These Two Supreme Gods are of equal rank, and both are the highest objects of faith. Light brings vigor to life, and darkness brings rest along with stillness. Light and dark, vigor and rest, change and permanence, body and spirit... That each pair exists not in "opposition" but in "harmony", with equal power, is the proper state of this world and its truth, the Scriptures teach.

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}アノイア教の歴史上の意義

 例えば現在のバイレステ共和国のような多様
な民族による集合国家は、アノイア教が存在し
なければ成立しなかったのではないだろうか。

 民族が異なれば崇拝する神も、社会慣習や価
値観も、全てが異なってくる。それが原因で、
民族間の対立や戦争、根深い偏見が生まれるこ
とも珍しくない。
 アノイア教成立以前も、複数の民族によって
構成された大国家は存在したが、民族的イデオ
ロギーの対立は、多民族国家の基盤をしばしば
破壊したからである。

 分かり易く言うと、「違う神様を信じている
奴、違う言葉を喋る奴、違う外見の奴なんかと
一緒にいたくない」「あいつ達の方が俺達より
も優遇されている、不愉快だ」などとなるのだ
ろうが、各民族の文化の基幹となる宗教が絡ん
でくるとその対立は一層激しさを増してくる。

 だが、アノイア教の存在は、各民族に1つの
共通の価値観を与えた。大小合わせて3百を越
える民族の集合体であるバイレステ共和国も、
「アノイア教という1つの宗教を国教とする国」
としてまとまることが出来たのである。
 もしアノイア教が存在しなければ、この大陸
の歴史はもっと凄惨なものになっていたであろ
う。少なくとも、この平和が千年も続かなかっ
たことだけは明らかだ。

 もちろん弊害もある。アノイア教の伝播によ
って、数多くの個性的な宗教が滅ぼされていっ
たし、現在もアノイア教以外の宗教を信仰して
いる人々にとって、アノイア教の他の宗教に対
する不寛容さは、彼等への暴力となって現れる
ことも少なくないからだ。

 その顕著な例が「神聖裁判」であろう。
異教徒の反乱を未然に防ぐためという名目で、
ある修道士の立案により2千年前に作られたこ
の制度は、制定からわずか5年で40万の人命
を奪ったと伝えられている。

 もっともその数年後には、「神聖裁判」の矛
先はアノイア教徒自身に向けられるようになっ
てしまう。
 まず「神聖裁判」は、アノイア教の教義に反
する発言をしたとして、教皇庁を非難した修道
士を処刑し、続いて教会への納税を怠った豪商
を処刑した。

 さらに、教皇、大司教のみであった裁判官任
命の権限が地区教会の司祭にまで拡大されると、
「信仰心に欠けている」と誰かに密告されただ
けで、十分な調査もなしに処刑されるという、
密告の恐怖が世界を覆うこととなった。

 幸いなことに、現在この制度はほとんどの国
で廃止されているが、「神聖裁判」の残した負
の遺産は少なくない。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}The Historical Significance of the Anoian Faith

A multi-ethnic federated state such as today's
Republic of Baileste could surely not have come
into being without the Anoian faith.

When peoples differ, the gods they worship,
their social customs and their values all differ
as well. Conflict and war between peoples and
deep-rooted prejudice often arise from this.
Even before the Anoian faith there were great
states composed of many peoples, but
ideological conflict between peoples often
destroyed the foundations of such states.

To put it simply, it comes down to "I don't want
to be around people who believe in some other
god, talk some other tongue or look different"
and "Those people get treated better than we
do, and it makes me sick". And when religion,
the backbone of each people's culture, becomes
involved, the conflict grows all the more violent.

But the Anoian faith gave every people one
common set of values. The Republic of Baileste,
an aggregate of over three hundred peoples
great and small, was able to unite as "a
country with one religion, the Anoian faith, as
its state religion". Had the Anoian faith not
existed, the history of this continent would
have been far more gruesome. At the very
least, it is clear that this peace would not have
lasted a thousand years.

Of course, it has its harmful effects as well.
The spread of the Anoian faith destroyed many
distinctive religions, and even today, for those
who follow other religions, the Anoian faith's
intolerance often takes the form of violence
against them.

The most striking example is surely the "Holy
Tribunal". Created two thousand years ago on
the proposal of a certain monk, on the pretext
of forestalling heathen revolts, this institution
is said to have taken four hundred thousand
lives within just five years of its founding.

Within a few years after that, however, the
"Holy Tribunal" turned its blade on Anoian
believers themselves. First it executed a monk
who had denounced the Holy See, for
statements contrary to Anoian doctrine, and
next a wealthy merchant who had neglected his
dues to the Church.

Then, when the power to appoint judges,
formerly held only by the Pope and archbishops,
was extended to the priests of local churches,
people were executed without adequate
investigation merely because someone informed
on them for "lacking faith", and the terror of
informers covered the world.

Fortunately, this institution has now been
abolished in most countries, but the "Holy
Tribunal" left no small negative legacy.{0b:07}

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}アノイア教の特殊な二元論

 聖書の一文、「ゼメンとゼウェアクは
天に唯二つであり唯一つである・・・」
 これは、この世に神はゼメンとゼウェアクし
か存在しない、また、ゼメンとゼウェアクは対
立した存在ではないという意味である。

 この文章が物語るように、光の神ゼメンと闇
の神ゼウェアクは伝統的な二元論的思想に基づ
いた善神・魔神ではない。

 「伝統的二元論」とは、世界の成り立ちや、
生成流転の原動力を善と悪の2大エネルギーに
求める思想である。アノイア教成立当時は特に
珍しい思想ではなく、特に預言者アノイアが生
を受けた地では一般的な思想でもあった。

 ではなぜ、ゼメンとゼウェアクは善悪の二神
にならなかったのか?

 教会は、これこそがアノイアの教えの素晴ら
しいところだと説いている。「対立」ではなく、
「調和・融合」こそが世界に幸福をもたらすの
だと。ある側面では真実であろう。だが、はた
してそれだけなのであろうか?

 肉体と精神、光と闇、生と死、善と悪、男と
女、敵と味方・・・ 人間は物事を考える時に
相対性を必要とする。思考には比較する対象が
必要なのである。
 「敵」がいなければ「味方」は存在しないし、
この世に「女」がいなければ「男」という性別
や名称は存在しない。
 二元論はこのような人間の心理から生まれた
思想なのだろう。

 しかし、現実はどうだろうか?

 善と悪の差は明瞭だろうか?
 法が悪を助け、善人を搾取する現実、善人で
あるはずの一個人が、集団になると罪悪感無く
弱者を排除する現実を多くの人が知っている。

 男と女の差は? 確かに生物学上の差はある
が、男性的・女性的という分け方はさほど明確
な差を持たない場合の方が多い。

 敵と味方の差は? 人は己の欲のために平気
で人を裏切り、裏切られまいと味方を猜疑する。
これらは5千年前も今も変わらない真実だろう。

 相反する2つの存在・・・ 現実の世界では、
その差は明瞭ではない場合の方が多いのではな
いだろうか。中間は幾らでも存在するし、表裏
一体であることも珍しくない。そして、いつ黒
が白になるか分からないものも少なくない。

 ゼメンとゼウェアクは、曖昧かつ複雑な現実
世界の代弁者なのではないだろうか。

 「調和」「融合」という言葉を持ち出したア
ノイア教はその点で革新的であった。現実の過
酷さと複雑さに疲れた人々にとって、アノイア
教の教義が抵抗無く受け入れられていったのは
このためではないだろうか。{0b:07}

strings.en:
{09:0f}{0b:06}The Peculiar Dualism of the Anoian Faith

A line from the Scriptures: "Zemen and Zeweak
are in heaven the only two and the only one..."
This means that no gods exist in this world but
Zemen and Zeweak, and also that Zemen and
Zeweak are not opposing beings.

As this passage shows, Zemen, god of light, and
Zeweak, god of darkness, are not a good god
and a demon god in the manner of traditional
dualist thought.

"Traditional dualism" is the thought that seeks
the origin of the world, and the motive force of
becoming and change, in two great energies of
good and evil. At the time of the founding of
the Anoian faith it was no unusual idea, and it
was common above all in the land where the
Prophet Anoia was born.

Why, then, did Zemen and Zeweak not become
two gods of good and evil?

The Church preaches that this is precisely the
splendor of Anoia's teaching: that not
"opposition" but "harmony and fusion" brings
happiness to the world. In one respect that is
surely true. But is that truly all there is to it?

Body and spirit, light and dark, life and death,
good and evil, man and woman, foe and friend...
When humans think about things, they need
relativity. Thought requires something to
compare against. Without "foe" there is no
"friend", and if there were no "woman" in this
world, neither the sex nor the word "man"
would exist. Dualism is surely a thought born of
this human psychology.

But what of reality?

Is the difference between good and evil clear?
Many know the reality in which law aids evil and
exploits the good, and in which an individual who
should be a good person, once in a group, casts
out the weak without guilt.

The difference between man and woman?
There is certainly a biological difference, but
more often than not the division into masculine
and feminine marks no very clear difference.

The difference between foe and friend? For
their own greed people betray others without a
qualm, and suspect their friends so as not to
be betrayed. This is as true today as it was
five thousand years ago.

Two opposing beings... In the real world, is the
difference between them not more often
unclear? There is any amount of middle ground,
and it is not unusual for the two to be sides of
one coin. And there are not a few cases where
no one can tell when black may turn white.

Might Zemen and Zeweak not be spokesmen for
this vague, complicated real world?

In bringing forward the words "harmony" and
"fusion", the Anoian faith was revolutionary in
this regard. Might this not be why people weary
of reality's harshness and complexity accepted
Anoian doctrine without resistance?{0b:07}

The Church preaches that this is precisely the splendor of Anoia's teaching: that not "opposition" but "harmony and fusion" brings happiness to the world. In one respect that is surely true. But is that truly all there is to it?

Body and spirit, light and dark, life and death, good and evil, man and woman, foe and friend... When humans think about things, they need relativity. Thought requires something to compare against. Without "foe" there is no "friend", and if there were no "woman" in this world, neither the sex nor the word "man" would exist. Dualism is surely a thought born of this human psychology.

But what of reality?

Is the difference between good and evil clear? Many know the reality in which law aids evil and exploits the good, and in which an individual who should be a good person, once in a group, casts out the weak without guilt.

The difference between man and woman? There is certainly a biological difference, but more often than not the division into masculine and feminine marks no very clear difference.

The difference between foe and friend? For their own greed people betray others without a qualm, and suspect their friends so as not to be betrayed. This is as true today as it was five thousand years ago.

Two opposing beings... In the real world, is the difference between them not more often unclear? There is any amount of middle ground, and it is not unusual for the two to be sides of one coin. And there are not a few cases where no one can tell when black may turn white.

Might Zemen and Zeweak not be spokesmen for this vague, complicated real world?

In bringing forward the words "harmony" and "fusion", the Anoian faith was revolutionary in this regard. Might this not be why people weary of reality's harshness and complexity accepted Anoian doctrine without resistance?

strings.jp: アノイア教と天使
strings.read: アノイア教と天使
strings.en: The Anoian Faith and Angels
strings.tl: The Anoian Faith and Angels

strings.jp:
{09:0f}{0b:06}アノイア教と天使

 古代から、人々は、神々に自然の力の数々を
投影してきた。落雷、日光、月光、闇、作物を
生み出す大地、海、風、星の運行、季節、死、
病気・・・ 古代の人々は、これらを司るもの
として多数の神々を用意した。アノイア教誕生
以前、世界は幾千もの神に満ちていたのである。
 しかし、アノイア教は、それまで多数の神々
が分散して所持していた能力や権威を、二至高
神ゼメンとゼウェアクに集中させた。そして二
至高神以外のいかなる神の存在をも否定したの
である。
 その結果、この二至高神はかつていかなる神
も所持したことのない絶大な権力を握ることと
なった。

 しかし、あまりに二至高神に力が集中しすぎ
たため、さらに、偶像崇拝の禁止なども重なり、
ゼメンとゼウェアクは非常に抽象化された存在
となってしまう。
 そして、かつての神々が持っていたような人
間臭さ、親しみやすさまでも失ってしまう。

 民衆は、いつの時代でも分かり易い奇跡や、
豊かな恵みや病気癒しなどの御利益を神に求め
るものである。
 またアノイア教を布教する際にも、二至高神
は余りにも抽象的過ぎ、多神教に慣れた人々に
とっては理解しづらいものがあった。

 そこでアノイア教会は、この問題を解決する
ために、北方、東方、西方の土着の神々を「天
使」という存在に置き換え、御利益や奇跡など
を人々に施す役目を「天使」と「十三聖者」と
「諸聖人」に委ねたのである。

 「天使」とは神と人の仲立ち・橋渡しをする
ために二至高神が造った被造物である・・・
教会は天使の存在をこのように説明する。
 天使が、二至高神と対等同列の存在ではなく、
二至高神によって造られた存在であるならば、
二至高神ゼメンとゼウェアクの立場はみじんも
揺るがないからである。

 また、預言者アノイアと十三聖者は、聖書の
中で神の像を祀ることを禁じたが、天使や聖者
の像を造ることを禁じたわけではない・・・
従って、天使の像を教会に飾っても何ら問題は
ない・・・

 こうして「天使」という名の、理解しやすく
親しみやすい守護者が誕生したのである。

-補足1-
 悪魔を神の楽園から追放するために天使達が
戦ったという話は、アノイア教の成立より2千
年も後に創られたものである。
 それ以前の天使は、神の言葉を人々に伝える
役目しか持っていなかったのだが、教皇庁の権
力の拡大に比例し、神及びアノイア教の守護者
としての役割が増していった。

-補足2-
 天使の存在を否定し、預言者アノイアや聖母
信仰までも否定したのがクラスダール東方正教
である。東方正教はゼメンとゼウェアク以外の
信仰を認めていない。また、教会にいかなる像
を飾ることも禁止している。{0b:07}
